stage: v26 late-response timing and GSO-friendly recovery

incomplete_acquisition.reason: Client QEMU laboratory Ethernet TCP port disconnected while its separate management NIC and guest remained live. Both physical lab pings failed; switch had3ports,71620drops and4MiB backlog. Collector later hit400samples/100s. First trigger of the fabric disconnection was not captured. No delivery or latency conclusion from this acquisition.

method.traffic: Same25,000noise/s70s,64ports oneIPv4,4096packet bursts;reverse useful UDP6000/s128bytes60s requested;same separate iperf3 3.18 startup-reorder benchmark
method.WAN: RTT300/jitter30 per A-B direction,or diagnostic RTT150/jitter15;half RTT delay each direction including mTLS,netem queue16384,no random loss;20physical pings before each trial
method.movement: Gateway only; next NAT change starts100/250ms after previous conntrack deletion ends. Actual first-to-last completion span retained; client profiles,keys,ports,binaries unchanged.
method.deadline: Same1s and100ordinary probes perprofile plus100frequent at50ms; same-clock client captures verify RTT,app timestamps separate.
method.timing: Rare endpoint and completed-send logs added equally to baseline and candidate. Journal timestamps are approximate; internal send duration is monotonic. Cross-VM wall timing is approximate.
method.GSO_control: Private nogso build disables all IPv4 TX offload in the exit standard bind,including ordinary traffic; not a replay-only isolated control. Upstream bind source is unchanged in the public candidate.
method.shaping_limit: GSO changes SKB grouping and application of seeded netem jitter; equal configured RTT does not guarantee equal per-datagram delay draws.
method.fabric: One acquisition had client laboratory TCP port loss and switch overflow while management NIC stayed live. First trigger unknown. Incomplete case excluded; client-only reboot restored model and probes. Valid completed windows require4ports and zero switch-drop delta.
method.builds: Offline cached compiler/modules in1core/1GiB entry guest; no compilation overlaps traffic; per-variant immutable source snapshots

bounds.workspace: one reusable current-batch arena and slice headers; payload size bounded by the selected attempt,at most2MiB extra transient storage; typical128x204bytes about25.5KiB; retained ciphertext never mutated

limits: One moving native profile plus stationary control; GUI clients,DPI,distributed noise,state exhaustion and multiple moving peers untested.
A1s deadline cannot be guaranteed through successive unavailable NAT mappings and a delayed authentication/return path. Deadlines were not widened.
This stage tests6000datagrams/s128byte payload,not maximum VPN throughput or higher PPS. Original replay-window and cache-age limits remain.
GSO reduces submission cost but does not authenticate an unknown endpoint or make a vanished path reachable. Global recovery limits unchanged.
Private noGSO control changes ordinary IPv4 TX too; coalescing also changes netem grouping. Single-case latency differences are not exact counterfactuals.
